items.title: Add community skills and partner connectors to AWS DevOps Agent
items.summary: AWS DevOps Agent investigates incidents with more context when it knows how your team operates and can reach the tools where your telemetry lives. In Extending AWS DevOps Agent with Skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers, Custom Agents and Connectors, we introduced the open-source Tools for DevOps Agent repository and the building blocks that extend […]
